title: Book Levels MicroSim
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: DGX Evaluation for Textbook Generation
description: Point at each step of a five-level staircase to compare the levels of intelligent textbooks, from static text to autonomous AI.

learningObjectives: The learner will compare the five levels of intelligent textbooks by the capability each level adds over the one below it.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Guided exploration by pointing at each level
keyQuestions: This book is a Level 2 textbook. Name one feature it would need to reach Level 3 and the reader data that feature would require.
assessmentOpportunities: Name the capability that each level adds over the one below it.
